title: Vendor-neutral read-only activation and selection for x6-canvas
objective: Extend @grafting/x6-canvas with immutable node/edge activation and externally synchronized read-only selection while preserving disabled editing, private X6 types, public API compatibility evidence, and deterministic disposal behavior.
validations: pnpm.cmd exec nx run-many -t check test api-check -p x6-canvas --skip-nx-cache
pnpm.cmd exec nx run-many -t check -p graph-x6 architecture-studio --skip-nx-cache
risks: A fresh visual smoke test of the new highlight interaction was not run because the in-app browser exposed no available backend in this session; typecheck, behavioral contracts, consumer checks, and the production build passed.
The adapter intentionally uses X6's encapsulated default view highlighter, so a future visual-theme change should be checked in a real browser.
